title: Crater Lake is DONE
body: Time to show Highway 97 some Big Deek Energy

title: Lost Lake is DONE
body:
Loot that spawns after every objective on the map is cleared is documented. This is the 90% treshhold that I consider as done.
Once we get to the playthrough that documents mission based loot spawns we can consider the area 99% done.

title: Cluster crafting summaries
body: Zoomed-out area summaries now show nearby loot as readable item chips and highlight everything craftable from that cluster, including Bandages, Molotovs, and Spiked Baseball Bats.

title: Iron Butt(e) Update
body: We should be now 90% done with Iron Butte.

title: Belknap is 90% complete
body: Belknap is nearly finished. Next up: Lost Lake.

title: Short update break
body: I will be away from the project for the next couple of days while I do not have access to my PC. Updates will resume next week.

title: Loot item icon refresh
body: All loot items with custom artwork have received their new map icons, including Cans, Gas Cans, Growlers, Rags, Nails, Alarm Clocks, Polystyrene, and Sterilizers.

title: Share the exact map view
body: The new Share view button copies a link to your current map position and zoom, along with any active item and spawn filters. Send it to someone and they will open the same view you are looking at.

title: Item filter search
body: The map legend now includes a search box, making it quicker to find and filter a specific item.

title: Zoomed-out map improvements
body: Map now has a way less aggressive item grouping when zoomed out.
Grenade now has a new “fancier” placeholder icon.

title: Bottle counter update
body: Combined Beer Bottles with Bottles so that we have a unified counter and so we can reduce clutter.
Also bottle now has a fancy icon (:
